embed.watch.note: an imported post: an embedded video player, shown as a link. platform: YouTube, Vimeo…; url: the video's address. Written into the post in the site's language

embed.listen.note: an imported post: an embedded audio player (Spotify, SoundCloud), shown as a link

embed.view.note: an imported post: an embedded post (X, Instagram, Bluesky) or page, shown as a link; platform may be a site's address (example.com)

embed.read.note: an imported post: a card for another post or article (Substack, a Ghost bookmark), shown as a link

embed.video.note: an imported post: a video file played in the post, shown as a link

embed.audio.note: an imported post: an audio file played in the post, shown as a link
